headline: Only 21.7% of Targeted Central Visayas Children Received Measles-Rubella Vaccine
seoTitle: Central Visayas MR Vaccination Reaches 21.7% | FMB News
seoDescription: DOH-7 data show only 137,042 of 630,214 targeted children received supplemental measles-rubella vaccination by August 29.
deck: The supplemental immunization activity covered children aged six to 59 months in Cebu, Bohol and the highly urbanized cities of Cebu, Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: DOH-7 data showed 137,042 children, or 21.7 percent of the 630,214 target population, received the supplemental measles-rubella vaccine by August 29.
That left 493,172 targeted children, or 78.3 percent, unreached at the end of the scheduled campaign period.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The activity targeted children aged six to 59 months in Bohol and Cebu provinces and in Cebu, Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue cities.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Low coverage leaves more children susceptible to measles and rubella and reduces the community protection public-health campaigns are designed to build.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Parents and guardians should check DOH and local health-office announcements for catch-up vaccination or extended schedules and ask health professionals about eligibility.
